script:
lease_name = frappe.form_dict.get("lease")

if not lease_name:
    frappe.throw("يجب تحديد العقد.")

lease = frappe.get_doc("Subscription", lease_name)
lease.check_permission("read")

if lease.party_type != "Customer" or not lease.party:
    frappe.throw("العقد غير مرتبط بمستأجر.")

payment_names = []

# السندات المرتبطة بالعقد مباشرة
direct_payments = frappe.get_all(
    "Payment Entry",
    filters={
        "custom_residential_lease": lease.name,
        "company": lease.company,
        "party_type": "Customer",
        "party": lease.party,
        "payment_type": "Receive",
        "docstatus": ["in", [0, 1]]
    },
    fields=["name"],
    limit_page_length=0
)

for payment in direct_payments:
    if payment.name not in payment_names:
        payment_names.append(payment.name)

# فواتير العقد المعتمدة
invoices = frappe.get_all(
    "Sales Invoice",
    filters={
        "subscription": lease.name,
        "company": lease.company,
        "customer": lease.party,
        "docstatus": 1
    },
    fields=["name"],
    limit_page_length=0
)

invoice_names = []

for invoice in invoices:
    invoice_names.append(invoice.name)

# السندات التي تسدد فواتير العقد
if invoice_names:
    references = frappe.get_all(
        "Payment Entry Reference",
        filters={
            "parenttype": "Payment Entry",
            "parentfield": "references",
            "reference_doctype": "Sales Invoice",
            "reference_name": ["in", invoice_names],
            "allocated_amount": [">", 0]
        },
        fields=["parent"],
        limit_page_length=0
    )

    for reference in references:
        if reference.parent not in payment_names:
            payment_names.append(reference.parent)

# عرض السندات التي يملك المستخدم صلاحية رؤيتها فقط
visible_names = []

if payment_names:
    visible_payments = frappe.get_list(
        "Payment Entry",
        filters={
            "name": ["in", payment_names],
            "company": lease.company,
            "party_type": "Customer",
            "party": lease.party,
            "payment_type": "Receive",
            "docstatus": ["in", [0, 1]]
        },
        fields=["name"],
        limit_page_length=0
    )

    for payment in visible_payments:
        visible_names.append(payment.name)

frappe.response["message"] = visible_names
